Fields.Name: Variable Bindings
Fields.Description: The bindings that drive this object's fields from behavior variables or character properties each frame.

Fields.Name: User Data
Fields.Description: A value for the game's own use; Havok doesn't read it.

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: The node's name. Used to find it in the outline and in the action scripts; it doesn't have to be unique.

Fields.Name: Enable
Fields.Description: Whether the modifier runs. A disabled modifier leaves the pose it's given unchanged.

Fields.Name: Handle Out
Fields.Description: The handle made (output), usually bound to a variable for other modifiers to use.

Fields.Name: Local Frame Name
Fields.Description: A local frame of the bone the handle is placed at. Empty: the bone itself.

Fields.Name: Ragdoll Bone
Fields.Description: The ragdoll bone the handle is on. -1 to use the animation bone.

Fields.Name: Animation Bone
Fields.Description: The animation bone the handle is on. -1 to use the ragdoll bone.
